meta.name: The Galaxy Railways
meta.description: In the future, the trains of the Galaxy Railways transport citizens between planets, protected from terrorists and aliens by the elite SDF. Though his father and brother were lost in service of the SDF, Manabu follows his dreams and joins the unit.

videos.title: Sacrifice
videos.overview: Manabu and his brother Mamoru stow away on their fathers train.

videos.title: A Knot in Time
videos.overview: Manabu tries to change his brother's fate when they come face to face in a Time-Knot.

videos.title: The Steering Wheel of Fate
videos.overview: Manabu is assigned to his father's old platoon.

videos.title: The Name Called Eternity
videos.overview: The Sirius Platoon goes in search of the mythical Ghost Train.

videos.title: Big One is Hijacked
videos.overview: Big One is stolen when Sirius Platoon is sent to Planet Leo Glando to investigate a crashed cargo train.

videos.title: Reason to Live (Part I)
videos.overview: Manabu and the team must investigate what caused a passenger train to explode in deep space.

videos.title: Reason to Live (Part II)
videos.overview: A criminal plans to destroy SDF Headquarters.

videos.title: Engine Song
videos.overview: Manabu is assigned to assist SDF's head mechanic.

videos.title: A Gallery of Memories
videos.overview: Bruce loses some of his memories to a magical creature.

videos.title: The Crossroads
videos.overview: The Sirius Platoon splits up to hunt for four escaped prisoners.

videos.title: Forget Me Not
videos.overview: Bulge reflects upon his life as the crew of Big One embark on a rescue mission.

videos.title: Twilight
videos.overview: The Sirius Platoon investigates a mysterious oasis unaffected by the catastrophe befalling the rest of the planet.

videos.title: Train Bound for Fate
videos.overview: The 777 Express comes under attack by aliens from another dimension.

videos.title: Bond
videos.overview: Louis and Manabu are assigned guard duty for the President of the Clarious Stellar Cluster.

videos.title: Joint Forces
videos.overview: The SDF is tasked with stopping a meteor stream that is on a collision course with Central Station.

videos.title: Comrade
videos.overview: A casino train is hijaked by pirates and crashed on the Planet Guin.

videos.title: The Goddess in Armor
videos.overview: David meets up with an old flame on a rescue mission.

videos.title: Life and Death
videos.overview: Bruce and Manabu search for an intruder at SDF Headquarters.

videos.title: Time of Tranquility
videos.overview: The leave of the Sirius, Spica and Vega Platoons is cut short.

videos.title: Choice
videos.overview: Manabu has been picked to join the Space Panzer Grenadiers.

videos.title: The Cruel Winds
videos.overview: Captain Bulge order's Sirius Platoon to do everything they can to save Louis.

videos.title: The Cruel Verdict
videos.overview: Sirius Platoon is disbanded as a result of Bulge's disobeying Ivanov's orders.

videos.title: Blazing Space
videos.overview: SPG Train 666 finds itself surrounded by enemy battleships.

videos.title: Echoes of Life
videos.overview: Sirius Platoon executes a precision attack against the Alfort command ship.

videos.title: Eternal Hope
videos.overview: Enemy ships surround Destiny Station.
